# Room and equipment reservation workflow

The app currently only supports activity signup. It does not manage rooms, equipment, or request approvals.

## Recommended Solution

- Add a reservation model for rooms and materials.
- Create endpoints for submitting reservation requests.
- Add a simple approval workflow for teachers to accept or reject requests.

## Context

Many club systems need to reserve rooms and gear for events, and this would make the app more useful for real school activity planning.
